Looping in my load test notes and the proposed rollback triggers.

Summary:
- Canary traffic plan: start at 5% of traffic for first 30 minutes, 25% for next 2 hours, then 100% if no regressions. Metrics to watch: 95th latency, model error rate, token error rates, and CPU/GPU queue depth.
- Rollback triggers (examples):
  1) 95th latency > 600ms sustained for 5 minutes -> immediate rollback to blue
  2) Model error rate > 1.5% for 10 minutes -> rollback
  3) Unhandled 500s increase > 0.5% baseline -> pause and investigate

I'll add these timeboxes into cutover-runbook_v1.md (attached) and push v1.1 today. Also adding a short checklist for smoke test ownership.

- Aditya
